activities.activity: Sleeping in bed, with the fan running quietly against the warm night air
Waking up, using the toilet, washing face and brushing teeth, taking a quick cool shower
Making and eating breakfast, boiling the kettle for tea and toasting bread
Getting dressed for work in light hot-weather clothing, packing a bag, checking phone for messages
Commuting to the nonprofit office during the morning peak
Working at the nonprofit office: coordinating community programs, answering emails, calling partner organisations and running intake meetings
Taking a lunch break, eating a packed lunch in the office kitchen area and resting in the shade
Continuing work: preparing program schedules, updating participant records on the computer and briefing volunteers
Commuting home from the office in the late afternoon heat, stopping briefly to buy a few groceries
Cooking and eating dinner, using the induction cooker and oven with the range hood on
Washing dishes, wiping the counters and putting away leftovers in the refrigerator
Unwinding on the sofa watching TV, keeping the air conditioner off during the evening peak-tax window
Taking a cool evening shower and getting ready for bed
Boiling the kettle for a cup of herbal tea and having a light snack
Wind-down time in bed: reading under the desk lamp with the fan on, then setting an alarm on the phone
Sleeping, with the fan running to stay comfortable through the hot night
